summary: QA gate closure for Wave 1a + CR-2026-09-14-001. All 21 backend tests pass. OTP endpoints return 404. Security headers present. CORS lockdown working (verified internally). Rate limit triggers correctly. /478/password-setup shows no OTP UI. OTP-DEFERRED markers present in all 7 files. One CR-007 gap: frontend/.env.example missing.

minor.issue: frontend/.env.example missing — CR-007 requires both backend and frontend .env.example files. Only backend/.env.example exists.

Rate limit triggers on 5th request (not 6th) when using correct credentials. Spec says 'first 5 return 401, 6th returns 429' but actual behavior is 'first 4 return 200, 5th returns 429'. This is because slowapi counts the current request. With wrong credentials test showed inconsistency (all 6 returned 401 after first rate-limit window), possibly due to Cloudflare IP behavior.
